data.title: Architecture Best Practice: Structured File-Native & Open-Source Software (OSS) Context Engineering — AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md Taxonomy, 10,000-Table Domain Partitioning, and Grep-Tax Mitigation
data.description: Empirical architecture best practices synthesizing 9,649 file-native agent experiments (McMillan, 2026) and 10,000 OSS GitHub repositories (Mohsenimofidi et al., MSR 2026): model-tier architecture selection, 10,000-table domain-partitioned YAML navigation, mitigating the Grep Tax, and structuring AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md / CLAUDE.md files across 14 categories and 5 linguistic styles.
